raw_features_dump.suggested_wager: Win/Place on 15e Big Opinion, Exacta and Trifecta Box 15, 2, 8, 11

contenders.handicapper_notes: Significant class dropper exiting a Saturday Metropolitan Class 3 Highway Handicap at Rosehill. Prior starts in competitive BM66 company at Albury and Wagga were full of merit in wet ground. Gets valuable 2kg weight relief with Dale Cole taking over. Maps into an ideal stalking position with canonical style P.

Brings peak fitness and outstanding recent form into this event after scoring a tough victory at Berrigan and a narrow second at Wangaratta on Heavy ground. Well suited by the Soft 6 conditions and Corowa layout. Races prominently under canonical style P.

Progressive 3yo gelding who comes off an eye-catching fourth beaten just a length in BM58 grade at Bathurst on a Heavy track. Drawn favorably in barrier 5 to track the speed nicely with Coriah Keatings aboard. Canonical style P.

Consistent wet-track specialist who has placed second in two of his last three starts at Wagga, including a narrow 0.2 length defeat in BM58 grade. Fresh for this off a 42-day let-up and nicely weighted on 55.5kg from an inside barrier. Canonical style S.

In career-best form having won two consecutive races at Wagga and Narrandera on rain-affected tracks. Must cope with a wide barrier draw but has strong finishing power for the 380m home straight. Canonical style S.

Possesses sharp early gate speed and lands the coveted rail run from barrier 1. Solid runner-up last start at Narrandera over 1000m. Capable of dictating terms or sitting right on the pace. Canonical style E.
